channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Rahm on DP World Tour: 'They're extorting players'
item.description: Jon Rahm spoke to reporters on Tuesday, ahead of the LIV event in Hong Kong, about his decision to reject the offer from the DP World Tour to allow LIV players to compete this year without future fines or releases, provided they pay fines owed.

item.title: Five-time PGA Tour winner on The Players: 'I think it's a major'
item.description: Speaking to reporters Tuesday ahead of his title defense at the Arnold Palmer Invitational, Russell Henley said he believes the PGA Tour’s flagship event at TPC Sawgrass should stand alongside the sport’s four majors.

item.title: After taking advantage of new model local rule, has Ludvig Åberg sparked a trend?
item.description: After Åberg took advantage of MLR G-9 at Pebble, replacing a damaged driver head on the spot, many players are following Åberg’s lead and keeping a backup driver head in their golf bags just to be safe.

item.title: Penske Performance: How Echavarria edged Lowry at Cognizant
item.description: Nico Echavarria won the Cognizant Classic with a late birdie and a late collapse by Shane Lowry. Penske Performance looks at the numbers behind the finish.

item.title: Thomas with 'fair' expectations in return after surgery
item.description: Justin Thomas is making his PGA Tour return at the Arnold Palmer Invitational, follow back surgery in November. He talked to Todd Lewis at Bay Hill regarding his health, his game and the trust factor.

item.title: Several LIV Golf players in Middle East amid conflict
item.description: Brentley Romine joins "Golf Central" with news that several LIV Golf players remain in the Middle East amid the U.S.-Israel and Iran conflict.

item.title: Stanford still runaway No. 1, just not invincible after huge upset
item.description: The Stanford women's golf team moved to 0-2 in match play after loss to 57th-ranked San Jose State on Monday.

item.description: Tee times, pairings and how to watch the first round of the PGA Tour's signature event, the Arnold Palmer Invitational.

item.description: Tee times, pairings and how to watch the second round of the PGA Tour's signature event, the Arnold Palmer Invitational.

item.title: Arnie Award recipient Fowler shares why it's special
item.description: Rickie Fowler was named the 2026 Arnie Award recipient. He express his admiration for the King and what Arnold Palmer meant to him in his early career.
